```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

HORIZONS <- c(1L, 3L, 6L, 12L)
ML_MODELS <- c("lasso", "post_lasso", "ridge", "farm", "rf", "bag", "xgb")
BASE_MODELS <- c("RW", "AR_BIC", ML_MODELS)
KEYS <- c("sample", "h", "origin_date", "target_date")
OOS_START <- as.Date("2012-02-01")
OOS_END <- as.Date("2026-07-01")
GR_WINDOW <- 60L
OUT <- "results/evaluation"
dir.create(OUT, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

save_csv <- function(x, name) {
  write.csv(x, file.path(OUT, name), row.names = FALSE)
}

show_table <- function(x) {
  print(tibble::as_tibble(x), n = Inf, width = Inf)
}
```


```{r load-forecasts}
forecast_paths <- function(sample) {
  c(
    paste0("results/forecasts/forecasts_benchmarks_", sample, ".csv"),
    paste0("results/farm-ridge/forecasts_ridge_farm_", sample, ".csv"),
    paste0("results/forecasts/forecasts_rf_xgb_", sample, ".csv"),
    paste0("results/lasso/forecasts_main_data_", sample, ".rds")
  )
}

standardise <- function(x, sample, horizons = HORIZONS) {
  stopifnot(all(c("model", "h", "origin_date", "target_date", "forecast", "actual") %in% names(x)))

  x %>%
    transmute(
      sample = .env$sample,
      model = as.character(model),
      h = as.integer(h),
      origin_date = as.Date(origin_date),
      target_date = as.Date(target_date),
      forecast = as.numeric(forecast),
      actual = as.numeric(actual)
    ) %>%
    filter(h %in% horizons, !is.na(forecast), target_date >= OOS_START, target_date <= OOS_END)
}

read_forecasts <- function(sample, required = TRUE) {
  paths <- forecast_paths(sample)
  missing <- paths[!file.exists(paths)]

  if (length(missing)) {
    if (required) stop("Missing forecast files: ", paste(missing, collapse = ", "))
    message("Skipping ", sample, ": missing ", paste(missing, collapse = ", "))
    return(NULL)
  }

  inputs <- list(read.csv(paths[1]), read.csv(paths[2]), read.csv(paths[3]), readRDS(paths[4]))
  bind_rows(lapply(inputs, standardise, sample = sample))
}

month_id <- function(d) as.integer(format(d, "%Y")) * 12L + as.integer(format(d, "%m"))

validate_forecasts <- function(data) {
  stopifnot(
    nrow(data) > 0L,
    !anyNA(data),
    all(is.finite(data$forecast)),
    all(is.finite(data$actual)),
    setequal(unique(data$model), BASE_MODELS),
    !anyDuplicated(data[c(KEYS, "model")]),
    all(month_id(data$target_date) - month_id(data$origin_date) == data$h)
  )

  coverage <- data %>%
    group_by(across(all_of(KEYS))) %>%
    summarise(
      n_models = n_distinct(model),
      actual_range = max(actual) - min(actual),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  counts <- data %>% count(model, h)
  stopifnot(
    nrow(coverage) == 174L * length(HORIZONS),
    all(coverage$n_models == length(BASE_MODELS)),
    all(coverage$actual_range < 1e-10),
    nrow(counts) == length(BASE_MODELS) * length(HORIZONS),
    all(counts$n == 174L)
  )

  invisible(data)
}

official <- read_forecasts("official")
validate_forecasts(official)

self <- read_forecasts("self", required = FALSE)
if (!is.null(self)) validate_forecasts(self)

all_data <- bind_rows(official, self)
```

## Equal-weight combination

```{r equal-weight}
combination <- all_data %>%
  filter(model %in% ML_MODELS) %>%
  group_by(across(all_of(KEYS))) %>%
  summarise(
    forecast = mean(forecast),
    actual = first(actual),
    n_models = n_distinct(model),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

stopifnot(all(combination$n_models == length(ML_MODELS)))

combination <- combination %>%
  transmute(across(all_of(KEYS)), model = "COMB_7", forecast, actual)

evaluated <- bind_rows(all_data, combination)
save_csv(combination, "combined_forecasts.csv")
```

## Rolling Granger–Ramanathan combination

```{r gr-combination}
gr_wide <- all_data %>%
  filter(model %in% ML_MODELS) %>%
  select(all_of(KEYS), model, forecast) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = model, values_from = forecast) %>%
  left_join(
    all_data %>% filter(model == "RW") %>% select(all_of(KEYS), actual),
    by = KEYS
  ) %>%
  arrange(sample, h, target_date)

stopifnot(!anyNA(gr_wide[c(ML_MODELS, "actual")]))
gr_formula <- reformulate(ML_MODELS, response = "actual")

make_gr <- function(data) {
  data <- arrange(data, target_date)
  forecasts <- vector("list", nrow(data))

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(data))) {
    train <- data %>%
      filter(target_date < data$origin_date[i]) %>%
      slice_tail(n = GR_WINDOW)

    if (nrow(train) < GR_WINDOW) next

    X <- model.matrix(gr_formula, data = train)
    y <- train$actual

    beta <- as.vector(MASS::ginv(X) %*% y)

    X_new <- model.matrix(
      delete.response(terms(gr_formula)),
      data = data[i, , drop = FALSE]
    )

    prediction <- as.numeric(X_new %*% beta)

    forecasts[[i]] <- data[i, KEYS] %>%
      mutate(
        model = "COMB_GR",
        forecast = prediction,
        actual = data$actual[i]
      )
  }

  bind_rows(forecasts)
}

gr_forecasts <- bind_rows(lapply(group_split(gr_wide, sample, h), make_gr))
stopifnot(nrow(gr_forecasts) > 0L, !anyNA(gr_forecasts))

show_table(gr_forecasts %>%
  group_by(sample, h) %>%
  summarise(N = n(), first_target = min(target_date), last_target = max(target_date), .groups = "drop"))

save_csv(gr_forecasts, "gr_combination_forecasts.csv")
```

## Forecast accuracy

```{r accuracy}
calculate_metrics <- function(data) {
  scores <- data %>%
    group_by(sample, model, h) %>%
    summarise(
      N = n(),
      MSE = mean((actual - forecast)^2),
      RMSE = sqrt(MSE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  benchmarks <- scores %>%
    filter(model %in% c("RW", "AR_BIC")) %>%
    select(sample, h, model, MSE) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = model, values_from = MSE, names_prefix = "benchmark_")

  scores %>%
    left_join(benchmarks, by = c("sample", "h")) %>%
    mutate(
      relative_MSE_RW = MSE / benchmark_RW,
      improvement_pct_RW = 100 * (1 - relative_MSE_RW),
      relative_MSE_AR = MSE / benchmark_AR_BIC,
      improvement_pct_AR = 100 * (1 - relative_MSE_AR)
    ) %>%
    select(-starts_with("benchmark_")) %>%
    arrange(sample, h, MSE)
}

metrics <- calculate_metrics(evaluated)
show_table(metrics)
save_csv(metrics, "model_metrics.csv")
```

## Diebold–Mariano tests

```{r dm-tests}
dm_hac <- function(d, bandwidth = NULL) {
  n <- length(d)
  if (n < 10L || any(!is.finite(d))) {
    return(c(statistic = NA_real_, p_value = NA_real_))
  }

  if (is.null(bandwidth)) bandwidth <- round(n^(1/3))
  bandwidth <- min(as.integer(bandwidth), n - 1L)
  u <- d - mean(d)
  lrv <- sum(u^2) / n

  if (bandwidth > 0L) {
    for (k in seq_len(bandwidth)) {
      gamma_k <- sum(u[(k + 1L):n] * u[seq_len(n - k)]) / n
      lrv <- lrv + 2 * (1 - k / (bandwidth + 1)) * gamma_k
    }
  }

  if (!is.finite(lrv) || lrv <= 0) {
    return(c(statistic = NA_real_, p_value = NA_real_))
  }

  statistic <- mean(d) / sqrt(lrv / n)
  c(statistic = statistic, p_value = 2 * pnorm(-abs(statistic)))
}

run_dm <- function(data, benchmark, candidates = NULL, bandwidth = NULL) {
  reference <- data %>%
    filter(model == benchmark) %>%
    select(all_of(KEYS), base_actual = actual, base_forecast = forecast)

  candidates_data <- data %>% filter(model != benchmark)
  if (!is.null(candidates)) {
    candidates_data <- candidates_data %>% filter(model %in% candidates)
  }

  candidates_data %>%
    inner_join(reference, by = KEYS) %>%
    arrange(sample, model, h, target_date) %>%
    mutate(loss_diff = (actual - forecast)^2 - (base_actual - base_forecast)^2) %>%
    group_by(sample, model, h) %>%
    group_modify(~ {
      test <- dm_hac(.x$loss_diff, bandwidth)
      tibble(
        N = nrow(.x),
        mean_loss_diff = mean(.x$loss_diff),
        DM_statistic = unname(test["statistic"]),
        p_value = unname(test["p_value"])
      )
    }) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(benchmark = benchmark, .before = 2)
}

dm_results <- bind_rows(
  run_dm(evaluated, "RW"),
  run_dm(evaluated, "AR_BIC")
) %>%
  group_by(sample, benchmark) %>%
  mutate(p_holm = p.adjust(p_value, method = "holm")) %>%
  ungroup()

combination_dm <- bind_rows(lapply(ML_MODELS, function(model_name) {
  run_dm(evaluated, benchmark = model_name, candidates = "COMB_7")
})) %>%
  group_by(sample) %>%
  mutate(p_holm = p.adjust(p_value, method = "holm")) %>%
  ungroup()

show_table(dm_results)
show_table(combination_dm)
save_csv(dm_results, "dm_results.csv")
save_csv(combination_dm, "dm_combination_vs_ml.csv")
```

## Granger–Ramanathan versus equal weighting

```{r gr-evaluation}
gr_comparison <- evaluated %>%
  semi_join(gr_forecasts %>% select(all_of(KEYS)), by = KEYS) %>%
  bind_rows(gr_forecasts)

gr_metrics <- calculate_metrics(gr_comparison)
save_csv(gr_metrics, "gr_vs_equal_weight_metrics.csv")
show_table(gr_metrics %>% filter(model %in% c("COMB_7", "COMB_GR")))

gr_dm <- bind_rows(
  run_dm(gr_comparison, "COMB_7", "COMB_GR"),
  run_dm(gr_comparison, "RW", c("COMB_7", "COMB_GR")),
  run_dm(gr_comparison, "AR_BIC", c("COMB_7", "COMB_GR")),
  bind_rows(lapply(ML_MODELS, function(model_name) {
    run_dm(gr_comparison, benchmark = model_name, candidates = "COMB_GR")
  }))
) %>%
  group_by(sample) %>%
  mutate(p_holm = p.adjust(p_value, method = "holm")) %>%
  ungroup()

show_table(gr_dm)
save_csv(gr_dm, "gr_vs_equal_weight_dm.csv")
```

## Statistical robustness

### HAC bandwidth sensitivity

```{r hac-sensitivity}
dm_sensitivity <- bind_rows(lapply(c(0L, 3L, 6L, 12L), function(lag) {
  run_dm(evaluated, "AR_BIC", candidates = c(ML_MODELS, "COMB_7"), bandwidth = lag) %>%
    mutate(HAC_lags = lag, .before = 1)
}))

show_table(dm_sensitivity %>% filter(sample == "official", model %in% c("ridge", "COMB_7")))
save_csv(dm_sensitivity, "dm_hac_sensitivity.csv")
```

### Loss-differential diagnostics

```{r loss-diagnostics, fig.width=11, fig.height=6}
loss_differentials <- evaluated %>%
  filter(sample == "official", model %in% c("AR_BIC", "ridge", "COMB_7")) %>%
  mutate(squared_error = (actual - forecast)^2) %>%
  select(h, target_date, model, squared_error) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = model, values_from = squared_error) %>%
  transmute(
    h, target_date,
    `Ridge minus AR(p)` = ridge - AR_BIC,
    `COMB_7 minus AR(p)` = COMB_7 - AR_BIC
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(-c(h, target_date), names_to = "comparison", values_to = "loss_diff")

plot_dm <- ggplot(loss_differentials, aes(target_date, loss_diff)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_line() +
  facet_grid(comparison ~ h, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(x = "Target date", y = "Squared-error loss differential") +
  theme_minimal()

print(plot_dm)
ggsave(file.path(OUT, "dm_loss_differentials_official.png"), plot_dm, width = 12, height = 7, dpi = 200)
```

## Self-adjusted CPI robustness

```{r self-robustness}
if (!is.null(self)) {
  robustness <- metrics %>%
    select(sample, model, h, MSE, RMSE,
           relative_MSE_RW, improvement_pct_RW,
           relative_MSE_AR, improvement_pct_AR) %>%
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = sample,
      values_from = c(MSE, RMSE,
                      relative_MSE_RW, improvement_pct_RW,
                      relative_MSE_AR, improvement_pct_AR)
    ) %>%
    arrange(model, h)

  show_table(robustness)
  save_csv(robustness, "official_vs_self_metrics.csv")

  plot_robustness <- ggplot(
    metrics %>% filter(model %in% c("RW", "AR_BIC", "COMB_7")),
    aes(h, MSE * 1e6, colour = model, linetype = sample)
  ) +
    geom_line() +
    geom_point() +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = HORIZONS) +
    facet_wrap(~ model, scales = "free_y") +
    labs(x = "Forecast horizon (months)", y = "MSE (× 10⁻⁶)") +
    theme_minimal()

  print(plot_robustness)
  ggsave(file.path(OUT, "mse_official_vs_self.png"), plot_robustness,
         width = 10, height = 5, dpi = 200)
} else {
  cat("Self-adjusted CPI analysis skipped: input forecasts unavailable.\n")
}
```

## US-predictor evaluation

```{r us-extension}
us_files <- tibble(
  path = c(
    "results/farm-ridge/forecasts_ridge_farm_official_us.csv",
    "results/farm-ridge/forecasts_ridge_farm_official_uskey.csv",
    "results/lasso/forecasts_lasso_official_us.csv",
    "results/lasso/forecasts_lasso_self_us.csv"
  ),
  target_sample = c("official", "official", "official", "self"),
  family = c("ridge_farm", "ridge_farm", "lasso", "lasso")
) %>%
  filter(file.exists(path))

read_us <- function(path, target_sample, family) {
  standardise(read.csv(path), sample = target_sample) %>%
    mutate(
      sample = .env$target_sample,
      model = case_when(
        family == "lasso" & model == "lasso" ~ "lasso_us",
        family == "lasso" & model == "post_lasso" ~ "post_lasso_us",
        TRUE ~ model
      )
    )
}

if (nrow(us_files) > 0L) {

  variants <- bind_rows(lapply(seq_len(nrow(us_files)), function(i) {
    read_us(
      us_files$path[i],
      us_files$target_sample[i],
      us_files$family[i]
    )
  })) %>%
    mutate(
      base_model = case_when(
        grepl("^post_lasso", model) ~ "post_lasso",
        grepl("^lasso", model) ~ "lasso",
        grepl("^ridge", model) ~ "ridge",
        grepl("^farm", model) ~ "farm",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      )
    )

  stopifnot(
    !anyNA(variants),
    !anyDuplicated(variants[c(KEYS, "model")])
  )

  baseline <- all_data %>%
    filter(model %in% c("lasso", "post_lasso", "ridge", "farm")) %>%
    select(
      all_of(KEYS),
      base_model = model,
      base_forecast = forecast,
      base_actual = actual
    )

  us_pairs <- variants %>%
    inner_join(
      baseline,
      by = c(KEYS, "base_model")
    )

  coverage <- variants %>%
    count(sample, model, h, name = "N_US") %>%
    left_join(
      us_pairs %>%
        count(sample, model, h, name = "N_matched"),
      by = c("sample", "model", "h")
    ) %>%
    mutate(N_matched = replace_na(N_matched, 0L))

  show_table(coverage)

  stopifnot(
    nrow(us_pairs) == nrow(variants),
    all(coverage$N_US == 174L),
    all(coverage$N_matched == 174L),
    all(abs(us_pairs$actual - us_pairs$base_actual) < 1e-10)
  )

  us_results <- us_pairs %>%
    group_by(sample, base_model, model, h) %>%
    summarise(
      N = n(),
      MSE_base = mean((base_actual - base_forecast)^2),
      MSE_US = mean((actual - forecast)^2),
      relative_MSE = MSE_US / MSE_base,
      improvement_pct = 100 * (1 - relative_MSE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    rename(
      baseline = base_model,
      US_model = model
    ) %>%
    arrange(sample, baseline, US_model, h)

  us_dm <- bind_rows(lapply(
    split(
      us_pairs,
      interaction(us_pairs$sample, us_pairs$model, drop = TRUE)
    ),
    function(pair) {

      base_name <- unique(pair$base_model)
      us_name <- unique(pair$model)

      comparison <- bind_rows(
        pair %>%
          transmute(
            across(all_of(KEYS)),
            model = base_name,
            forecast = base_forecast,
            actual = base_actual
          ),
        pair %>%
          transmute(
            across(all_of(KEYS)),
            model = us_name,
            forecast,
            actual
          )
      )

      run_dm(
        comparison,
        benchmark = base_name,
        candidates = us_name
      )
    }
  )) %>%
    group_by(sample) %>%
    mutate(p_holm = p.adjust(p_value, method = "holm")) %>%
    ungroup()

  show_table(us_results)
  show_table(us_dm)

  save_csv(us_results, "us_extension_metrics.csv")
  save_csv(us_dm, "us_extension_dm.csv")

} else {
  cat("US-predictor extension skipped: forecast files unavailable.\n")
}
```
